display.purpose: Georgia card names, headings and themed controls; generated title art where specified.

body.purpose: System sans for score data and supporting interface text.

motion.name: deal-travel
motion.purpose: Travel and flip finish with one card-dealt.wav playback per card.

motion.name: deal-flip
motion.purpose: Travel and flip finish with one card-dealt.wav playback per card.

motion.name: resolve-travel
motion.purpose: Room card to discard/equipment; Forge trophies use the same discard flights.

motion.name: carryover-slide
motion.purpose: Survivor to rightmost slot before dealing.

motion.name: flee-flip
motion.purpose: Flee and Hand of Fate return cards face down with 320ms travel and 50ms stagger before redealing.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No spatial travel, flips or card/fan transitions; dealing holds after the fade until its sound finishes.

motion.name: attack-slash
motion.purpose: One upper-left to lower-right strike on a stationary monster or barricade; remove before travel and cancel on restart.

motion.name: healing-radiance
motion.purpose: A soft diffuse golden glow brightens, expands and fades on healing-card use before travel, including use at full health; no glow for spent-card discards.

motion.name: magic-radiance
motion.purpose: A soft diffuse purple glow shares healing radiance geometry and keyframes on Joker Play and all four cosmic Activate actions before travel; Discard skips it. Remove before cloning and cancel on restart.

components.name: Enter the dungeon
components.description: Text action beneath the illustrated deck.
components.css: .ds-enter { border:0; border-radius:0; padding:15px 38px; color:#ebd1a0; background:transparent; font:small-caps 1.5rem Georgia,serif; letter-spacing:.06em; text-shadow:0 3px 4px #000; cursor:pointer; }.ds-enter:hover { color:#fff0cf; }.ds-enter:active { transform:translateY(1px); }.ds-enter:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f4ce79; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Initials
components.description: Three-letter score entry; uppercase presentation and visible keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Your initials <input class="ds-initials" aria-label="Your initials" maxlength="3" placeholder="AAA"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { color:#ead8b5; font:1.1rem Georgia,serif; }.ds-initials { display:block; width:118px; min-height:52px; padding:8px 8px 8px 16px; border:1px solid #bfa16a; border-radius:4px; background:#10140f; color:#eddfbd; caret-color:#eddfbd; font:1.65rem Georgia,serif; letter-spacing:.22em; text-transform:uppercase; }.ds-initials::placeholder { color:#bcb09b; }.ds-initials:disabled { opacity:.65; }.ds-initials:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f4ce79; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Guide navigation
components.description: Text chapter buttons in the illustrated guide toolbar.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:22px; }.ds-nav button { cursor:pointer; padding:8px 0; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:#d0bc96; font:1rem Georgia,serif; }.ds-nav button:hover { color:#fff0d2; }.ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f4ce79; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Card frame
components.description: Frame and nameplate preview; painted artwork is supplied separately by the card catalogue.
components.html: Crypt Guardian
components.css: .ds-card { width:210px; aspect-ratio:2/3; display:grid; grid-template-rows:1fr auto; padding:5px; border:2px solid #8a6b40; border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ad915c,#34271d 5%,#8a683d 6%,#2b241a 7%,#5c422a 94%,#be9f63 96%,#3c2d1e); box-shadow:0 12px 22px #0009; }.ds-art { background:#242e2b; }.ds-name { color:#251e15; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#eddfbd,#c7ae81); border-top:2px solid #8a6b40; padding:15px 8px; text-align:center; font:500 1.1rem/1.15 Georgia,serif; }

components.name: Score table
components.description: HTML rows above the illustrated ledger plate.
components.css: .ds-scores { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; color:#eddfbd; font:1.05rem Georgia,serif; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; text-align:left; }.ds-scores thead th { padding:0 8px 10px; border-bottom:1px solid #8a6b40; color:#cfbf9f; font:.75rem system-ui,sans-serif; }.ds-scores td,.ds-scores tbody th { padding:4px 8px; border-bottom:1px solid #8a6b403d; }.ds-scores td:last-child,.ds-scores th:last-child { text-align:right; }

components.name: Dungeon sight popover
components.description: Temporary untitled reveal beside the draw pile after a successful Sight activation and completed card motion. X or Escape inside dismisses it permanently and focuses the room heading; the next accepted game action also clears it. No reopen control. Miniature frame specimen; painted artwork comes from the card catalogue.

    Crypt Guardian

  2. Then

    Crypt Guardian

components.css: .ds-sight { position:relative; width:448px; padding:38px 14px 14px; color:#eddfbd; background:#171714; border:1px solid #8a6b40; border-radius:4px; box-shadow:4px 12px 22px #0009; }.ds-sight ol { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; }.ds-sight li { min-width:0; }.ds-sight .ds-order { margin:0 0 8px; color:#cfbf9f; font:.85rem Georgia,serif; }.ds-sight .ds-mini-card { aspect-ratio:2/3; display:grid; grid-template-rows:1fr auto; overflow:hidden; border:2px solid #8a6b40; border-radius:6px; background:#242e2b; box-shadow:2px 6px 10px #0009; }.ds-sight .ds-name { min-height:36px; padding:9px 3px; color:#251e15; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#eddfbd,#c7ae81); border-top:2px solid #8a6b40; text-align:center; font:500 .65rem/1.15 Georgia,serif; }.ds-sight .ds-close { position:absolute; top:4px; right:4px; display:grid; place-items:center; width:32px; height:32px; padding:4px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:#eddfbd; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:none; }.ds-sight .ds-close svg { width:22px; height:22px; }.ds-sight .ds-close:hover { background:#bfa16a1c; color:#f4ce79; }.ds-sight .ds-close:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #f4ce79; outline-offset:5px; }

components.description: Temporary untitled dungeon-top preview after Mirror activation and completed card motion. narrative.overview: An atmospheric desktop fantasy card table. The paintings dominate; bronze image controls and physical card movement carry the surrounding interface. Bronze frames, parchment nameplates and dark charcoal/table materials give the cards their physical character. The guide is a reading surface within this same world.
keyCharacteristics: Painted cards with bronze frames and parchment nameplates.
Physical card movement across a desktop table.
Illustrated controls with keyboard access and reduced motion.
Slate Settings dialog with side-by-side audio and optional house rules.

rules.name: Desktop scope
rules.body: 1100px minimum table; four fixed slots. No mobile layout is implemented.

rules.name: Separate motion from rules
rules.body: Keep card animation in the presentation layer. Hide full source cards and commit destination slots before restoring visibility.

rules.name: Outcome dismissal
rules.body: Only Play again dismisses outcomes; guide allows Return or Escape.

dos: Keep gameplay, paintings and readable costs central.
Preserve keyboard access and reduced motion.
Retain exact prompts and originals through the artwork index; keep transient review captures out of Git.
donts: Do not add mobile layouts by default, visible type badges, redundant helper text, promotional copy, invented lore, generic web-app button boxes or a joined action-panel extension below cards.
